svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One 12.2 mm hole in the front wall, on the middle of the wall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 26 mm above the outside of the floor, for the M12 gland that

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pack lead passes through. Pilot 3 mm, then step drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: a hook-and-loop pad 38 x 60 mm stuck to the middle of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor; its mate goes on the pack's underside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pack (38 x 70 x 38 mm at most) lies on the pad, long side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front to back, 3.5 mm clear of the gland nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the gland goes in from outside, seal outside, nut inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pack sits on the pad with its lead reaching the gland

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: without strain, and the cover closes without touching it.
